versos.grego: Ἀνὴρ δέ τις ἐν Καισαρίᾳ ὀνόματι Κορνήλιος, ἑκατοντάρχης ἐκ σπείρης τῆς καλουμένης Ἰταλικῆς,

controles.web: Now there was a certain man in Caesarea, Cornelius by name, a centurion of what was called the Italian Regiment,
controles.kjv: There was a certain man in Cesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian band,
controles.livre: E havia um certo homem em Cesareia, de nome Cornélio, centurião, do esquadrão chamado Italiano;

versos.grego: εὐσεβὴς καὶ φοβούμενος τὸν Θεὸν σὺν παντὶ τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ, ποιῶν ἐλεημοσύνας πολλὰς τῷ λαῷ καὶ δεόμενος τοῦ Θεοῦ διὰ παντός,

controles.web: a devout man, and one who feared God with all his house, who gave gifts for the needy generously to the people, and always prayed to God.
controles.kjv: A devout man, and one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God alway.
controles.livre: Devoto, e temente a Deus, com toda a sua casa; e que fazia muitas doações ao povo, e continuamente orava a Deus.

versos.grego: εἶδεν ἐν ὁράματι φανερῶς, ὡσεὶ περὶ ὥραν ἐνάτην τῆς ἡμέρας, ἄγγελον τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰσελθόντα πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ εἰπόντα αὐτῷ Κορνήλιε.

controles.web: At about the ninth hour of the day, he clearly saw in a vision an angel of God coming to him, and saying to him, “Cornelius!”
controles.kjv: He saw in a vision evidently about the ninth hour of the day an angel of God coming in to him, and saying unto him, Cornelius.
controles.livre: Ele viu claramente em visão, cerca da hora nona do dia, a um anjo de Deus, que vinha a ele, e lhe dizia: Cornélio!

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἀτενίσας αὐτῷ καὶ ἔμφοβος γενόμενος εἶπεν Τί ἐστιν, Κύριε; εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ Αἱ προσευχαί σου καὶ αἱ ἐλεημοσύναι σου ἀνέβησαν εἰς μνημόσυνον ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: He, fastening his eyes on him, and being frightened, said, “What is it, Lord?”   He said to him, “Your prayers and your gifts to the needy have gone up for a memorial before God.
controles.kjv: And when he looked on him, he was afraid, and said, What is it, Lord? And he said unto him, Thy prayers and thine alms are come up for a memorial before God.
controles.livre: E ele, olhando-lhe atentamente, e muito atemorizado, disse: O que é, Senhor?E disse-lhe: Tuas orações e doações subiram à memória diante de Deus.

versos.grego: καὶ νῦν πέμψον ἄνδρας εἰς Ἰόππην καὶ μετάπεμψαι Σίμωνά τινα ὃς ἐπικαλεῖται Πέτρος·

controles.web: Now send men to Joppa, and get Simon, who is also called Peter.
controles.kjv: And now send men to Joppa, and call for one Simon, whose surname is Peter:
controles.livre: E agora envia homens a Jope, e manda chamar a Simão, que tem por sobrenome Pedro.

versos.grego: οὗτος ξενίζεται παρά τινι Σίμωνι βυρσεῖ, ᾧ ἐστιν οἰκία παρὰ θάλασσαν.

controles.web: He lodges with one Simon, a tanner, whose house is by the seaside.
controles.kjv: He lodgeth with one Simon a tanner, whose house is by the sea side: he shall tell thee what thou oughtest to do.
controles.livre: Este está hospedado na casa de um Simão curtidor, cuja casa é junto ao mar.

versos.grego: ὡς δὲ ἀπῆλθεν ὁ ἄγγελος ὁ λαλῶν αὐτῷ, φωνήσας δύο τῶν οἰκετῶν καὶ στρατιώτην εὐσεβῆ τῶν προσκαρτερούντων αὐτῷ,

controles.web: When the angel who spoke to him had departed, Cornelius called two of his household servants and a devout soldier of those who waited on him continually.
controles.kjv: And when the angel which spake unto Cornelius was departed, he called two of his household servants, and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually;
controles.livre: E tendo partido o anjo que falava com Cornélio, ele chamou a dois de seus servos, e a um soldado devoto, dos que permaneciam continuamente com ele.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐξηγησάμενος ἅπαντα αὐτοῖς ἀπέστειλεν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν Ἰόππην.

controles.web: Having explained everything to them, he sent them to Joppa.
controles.kjv: And when he had declared all these things unto them, he sent them to Joppa.
controles.livre: E tendo lhes contado tudo, enviou-os a Jope.

versos.grego: Τῇ δὲ ἐπαύριον ὁδοιπορούντων ἐκείνων καὶ τῇ πόλει ἐγγιζόντων ἀνέβη Πέτρος ἐπὶ τὸ δῶμα προσεύξασθαι περὶ ὥραν ἕκτην.

controles.web: Now on the next day as they were on their journey, and got close to the city, Peter went up on the housetop to pray at about noon.
controles.kjv: On the morrow, as they went on their journey, and drew nigh unto the city, Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour:
controles.livre: E no dia seguinte, enquanto estes iam pelo caminho, e chegando perto da cidade, Pedro subiu ao telhado para orar, quase à hora sexta.

versos.grego: ἐγένετο δὲ πρόσπεινος καὶ ἤθελεν γεύσασθαι· παρασκευαζόντων δὲ αὐτῶν ἐγένετο ἐπ’ αὐτὸν ἔκστασις,

controles.web: He became hungry and desired to eat, but while they were preparing, he fell into a trance.
controles.kjv: And he became very hungry, and would have eaten: but while they made ready, he fell into a trance,
controles.livre: E tendo ele fome, quis comer; e enquanto estavam lhe preparando, caiu sobre ele um êxtase.

versos.grego: καὶ θεωρεῖ τὸν οὐρανὸν ἀνεῳγμένον καὶ καταβαῖνον σκεῦός τι ὡς ὀθόνην μεγάλην, τέσσαρσιν ἀρχαῖς καθιέμενον ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς,

controles.web: He saw heaven opened and a certain container descending to him, like a great sheet let down by four corners on the earth,
controles.kjv: And saw heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending unto him, as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners, and let down to the earth:
controles.livre: E ele viu o céu aberto, e descia a ele um certo objeto, como um grande lençol, abaixando-se pelas quatro pontas à terra;

versos.grego: ἐν ᾧ ὑπῆρχεν πάντα τὰ τετράποδα καὶ ἑρπετὰ τῆς γῆς καὶ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ.

controles.web: in which were all kinds of four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, reptiles, and birds of the sky.
controles.kjv: Wherein were all manner of fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.
controles.livre: Em que havia de todos os animais quadrúpedes da terra, e animais selvagens, e répteis, e aves do céu.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐγένετο φωνὴ πρὸς αὐτόν Ἀναστάς, Πέτρε, θῦσον καὶ φάγε.

controles.web: A voice came to him, “Rise, Peter, kill and eat!”
controles.kjv: And there came a voice to him, Rise, Peter; kill, and eat.
controles.livre: E veio-lhe uma voz, dizendo : Pedro, mata e come.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Πέτρος εἶπεν Μηδαμῶς, Κύριε, ὅτι οὐδέποτε ἔφαγον πᾶν κοινὸν καὶ ἀκάθαρτον.

controles.web: But Peter said, “Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean.”
controles.kjv: But Peter said, Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean.
controles.livre: Mas Pedro disse: De maneira nenhuma, Senhor; porque nunca comi coisa alguma ordinária ou impura.

versos.grego: καὶ φωνὴ πάλιν ἐκ δευτέρου πρὸς αὐτόν Ἃ ὁ Θεὸς ἐκαθάρισεν σὺ μὴ κοίνου.

controles.web: A voice came to him again the second time, “What God has cleansed, you must not call unclean.”
controles.kjv: And the voice spake unto him again the second time, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.
controles.livre: E a voz voltou a dizer ,pela segunda vez: O que Deus purificou, não faças tu como se fosse ordinário.

versos.grego: τοῦτο δὲ ἐγένετο ἐπὶ τρίς, καὶ εὐθὺς ἀνελήμφθη τὸ σκεῦος εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν.

controles.web: This was done three times, and immediately the vessel was received up into heaven.
controles.kjv: This was done thrice: and the vessel was received up again into heaven.
controles.livre: E isto aconteceu três vezes; e o objeto voltou a ser recolhido acima ao céu.

versos.grego: Ὡς δὲ ἐν ἑαυτῷ διηπόρει ὁ Πέτρος τί ἂν εἴη τὸ ὅραμα ὃ εἶδεν, ἰδοὺ οἱ ἄνδρες οἱ ἀπεσταλμένοι ὑπὸ τοῦ Κορνηλίου διερωτήσαντες τὴν οἰκίαν τοῦ Σίμωνος ἐπέστησαν ἐπὶ τὸν πυλῶνα,

controles.web: Now while Peter was very perplexed in himself what the vision which he had seen might mean, behold, the men who were sent by Cornelius, having made inquiry for Simon’s house, stood before the gate,
controles.kjv: Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean, behold, the men which were sent from Cornelius had made enquiry for Simon’s house, and stood before the gate,
controles.livre: E enquanto Pedro estava pensando perplexo consigo mesmo o que seria aquela visão que ele tinha visto, eis que os homens que tinham sido enviados por Cornélio, perguntando pela casa de Simão, pararam à porta.

versos.grego: καὶ φωνήσαντες ἐπυνθάνοντο εἰ Σίμων ὁ ἐπικαλούμενος Πέτρος ἐνθάδε ξενίζεται.

controles.web: and called and asked whether Simon, who was also called Peter, was lodging there.
controles.kjv: And called, and asked whether Simon, which was surnamed Peter, were lodged there.
controles.livre: E chamando, perguntaram se Simão, que tinha por sobrenome Pedro, estava hospedado ali.

versos.grego: Τοῦ δὲ Πέτρου διενθυμουμένου περὶ τοῦ ὁράματος εἶπεν τὸ Πνεῦμα Ἰδοὺ ἄνδρες δύο ζητοῦντές σε·

controles.web: While Peter was pondering the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Behold, three  men seek you.
controles.kjv: While Peter thought on the vision, the Spirit said unto him, Behold, three men seek thee.
controles.livre: E estando Pedro pensando naquela visão, o Espírito lhe disse: Eis que três homens te buscam.

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ ἀναστὰς κατάβηθι, καὶ πορεύου σὺν αὐτοῖς μηδὲν διακρινόμενος, ὅτι ἐγὼ ἀπέσταλκα αὐτούς.

controles.web: But arise, get down, and go with them, doubting nothing; for I have sent them.”
controles.kjv: Arise therefore, and get thee down, and go with them, doubting nothing: for I have sent them.
controles.livre: Então levanta-te, desce, e vai com eles, sem duvidar; porque eu os enviei.

versos.grego: καταβὰς δὲ Πέτρος πρὸς τοὺς ἄνδρας εἶπεν Ἰδοὺ ἐγώ εἰμι ὃν ζητεῖτε· τίς ἡ αἰτία δι’ ἣν πάρεστε;

controles.web: Peter went down to the men, and said, “Behold, I am he whom you seek. Why have you come?”
controles.kjv: Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto him from Cornelius; and said, Behold, I am he whom ye seek: what is the cause wherefore ye are come?
controles.livre: E Pedro, tendo descido aos homens,  disse: Eis que eu sou a quem buscais; qual é o motivo pelo qual estais aqui?

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν Κορνήλιος ἑκατοντάρχης, ἀνὴρ δίκαιος καὶ φοβούμενος τὸν Θεὸν, μαρτυρούμενός τε ὑπὸ ὅλου τοῦ ἔθνους τῶν Ἰουδαίων, ἐχρηματίσθη ὑπὸ ἀγγέλου ἁγίου μεταπέμψασθαί σε εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀκοῦσαι ῥήματα παρὰ σοῦ.

controles.web: They said, “Cornelius, a centurion, a righteous man and one who fears God, and well spoken of by all the nation of the Jews, was directed by a holy angel to invite you to his house, and to listen to what you say.”
controles.kjv: And they said, Cornelius the centurion, a just man, and one that feareth God, and of good report among all the nation of the Jews, was warned from God by an holy angel to send for thee into his house, and to hear words of thee.
controles.livre: E eles disseram: Cornélio, que é centurião, homem justo e temente a Deus, e que tem bom testemunho de toda a nação dos judeus, foi revelado por um santo anjo para te chamar até a casa dele, e ouvir de tuas palavras.

versos.grego: εἰσκαλεσάμενος οὖν αὐτοὺς ἐξένισεν. Τῇ δὲ ἐπαύριον ἀναστὰς ἐξῆλθεν σὺν αὐτοῖς, καί τινες τῶν ἀδελφῶν τῶν ἀπὸ Ἰόππης συνῆλθον αὐτῷ.

controles.web: So he called them in and lodged them. On the next day Peter arose and went out with them, and some of the brothers from Joppa accompanied him.
controles.kjv: Then called he them in, and lodged them. And on the morrow Peter went away with them, and certain brethren from Joppa accompanied him.
controles.livre: Então chamando-os para dentro, recebeu-os em casa. Mas no dia seguinte, Pedro foi com eles; e foram com ele alguns dos irmãos de Jope.

versos.grego: τῇ δὲ ἐπαύριον εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὴν Καισάριαν· ὁ δὲ Κορνήλιος ἦν προσδοκῶν αὐτοὺς, συνκαλεσάμενος τοὺς συγγενεῖς αὐτοῦ καὶ τοὺς ἀναγκαίους φίλους.

controles.web: On the next day they entered into Caesarea. Cornelius was waiting for them, having called together his relatives and his near friends.
controles.kjv: And the morrow after they entered into Cesarea. And Cornelius waited for them, and had called together his kinsmen and near friends.
controles.livre: E no dia seguinte chegaram a Cesareia. E Cornélio estava esperando por eles, tendo chamado a seus parentes e amigos mais íntimos.

versos.grego: Ὡς δὲ ἐγένετο τοῦ εἰσελθεῖν τὸν Πέτρον, συναντήσας αὐτῷ ὁ Κορνήλιος πεσὼν ἐπὶ τοὺς πόδας προσεκύνησεν.

controles.web: When Peter entered, Cornelius met him, fell down at his feet, and worshiped him.
controles.kjv: And as Peter was coming in, Cornelius met him, and fell down at his feet, and worshipped him.
controles.livre: E sucedeu que, ao Pedro entrar, Cornélio se encontrou com ele, e caindo aos pés dele, adorou-o.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Πέτρος ἤγειρεν αὐτὸν λέγων Ἀνάστηθι· καὶ ἐγὼ αὐτὸς ἄνθρωπός εἰμι.

controles.web: But Peter raised him up, saying, “Stand up! I myself am also a man.”
controles.kjv: But Peter took him up, saying, Stand up; I myself also am a man.
controles.livre: Mas Pedro o levantou, dizendo: Levanta-te; eu mesmo também sou um ser humano.

versos.grego: καὶ συνομιλῶν αὐτῷ εἰσῆλθεν, καὶ εὑρίσκει συνεληλυθότας πολλούς,

controles.web: As he talked with him, he went in and found many gathered together.
controles.kjv: And as he talked with him, he went in, and found many that were come together.
controles.livre: E tendo conversado com ele, entrou; e achou a muitos que ali tinham se reunido.

versos.grego: ἔφη τε πρὸς αὐτούς Ὑμεῖς ἐπίστασθε ὡς ἀθέμιτόν ἐστιν ἀνδρὶ Ἰουδαίῳ κολλᾶσθαι ἢ προσέρχεσθαι ἀλλοφύλῳ· κἀμοὶ ὁ Θεὸς ἔδειξεν μηδένα κοινὸν ἢ ἀκάθαρτον λέγειν ἄνθρωπον·

controles.web: He said to them, “You yourselves know how it is an unlawful thing for a man who is a Jew to join himself or come to one of another nation, but God has shown me that I shouldn’t call any man unholy or unclean.
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, Ye know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company, or come unto one of another nation; but God hath shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean.
controles.livre: E disse-lhes: Vós sabeis como não é lícito a um homem judeu juntar-se de estrangeiros, ou aproximar-se deles; mas Deus me mostrou que a ninguém chame de ordinário ou impuro.

versos.grego: διὸ καὶ ἀναντιρρήτως ἦλθον μεταπεμφθείς. πυνθάνομαι οὖν Τίνι λόγῳ μετεπέμψασθέ με.

controles.web: Therefore also I came without complaint when I was sent for. I ask therefore, why did you send for me?”
controles.kjv: Therefore came I unto you without gainsaying, as soon as I was sent for: I ask therefore for what intent ye have sent for me?
controles.livre: Portanto eu, tendo sido chamado, vim sem qualquer oposição de minha parte . Então eu pergunto: por que motivo me mandastes chamar?

versos.grego: Καὶ ὁ Κορνήλιος ἔφη Ἀπὸ τετάρτης ἡμέρας μέχρι ταύτης τῆς ὥρας ἤμην τὴν ἐνάτην προσευχόμενος ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ μου, καὶ ἰδοὺ ἀνὴρ ἔστη ἐνώπιόν μου ἐν ἐσθῆτι λαμπρᾷ,

controles.web: Cornelius said, “Four days ago, I was fasting until this hour, and at the ninth hour, I prayed in my house, and behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,
controles.kjv: And Cornelius said, Four days ago I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour I prayed in my house, and, behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,
controles.livre: E Cornélio disse: Há quatro dias que, até esta hora eu estava jejuando, e orava à hora nona em minha casa.

versos.grego: καὶ φησίν Κορνήλιε, εἰσηκούσθη σου ἡ προσευχὴ καὶ αἱ ἐλεημοσύναι σου ἐμνήσθησαν ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: and said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer is heard, and your gifts to the needy are remembered in the sight of God.
controles.kjv: And said, Cornelius, thy prayer is heard, and thine alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God.
controles.livre: E eis que um homem se pôs diante de mim com uma roupa brilhante, e disse: Cornélio, tura oração tem sido ouvida, e tuas doações têm sido lembradas diante de Deus.

versos.grego: πέμψον οὖν εἰς Ἰόππην καὶ μετακάλεσαι Σίμωνα ὃς ἐπικαλεῖται Πέτρος· οὗτος ξενίζεται ἐν οἰκίᾳ Σίμωνος βυρσέως παρὰ θάλασσαν.

controles.web: Send therefore to Joppa, and summon Simon, who is also called Peter. He lodges in the house of Simon a tanner, by the seaside. When he comes, he will speak to you.’
controles.kjv: Send therefore to Joppa, and call hither Simon, whose surname is Peter; he is lodged in the house of one Simon a tanner by the sea side: who, when he cometh, shall speak unto thee.
controles.livre: Envia pois a Jope, e manda chamar a Simão, que tem por sobrenome Pedro; este se hospeda na casa de Simão o curtidor, junto ao mar.

versos.grego: ἐξαυτῆς οὖν ἔπεμψα πρὸς σέ, σύ τε καλῶς ἐποίησας παραγενόμενος. νῦν οὖν πάντες ἡμεῖς ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ πάρεσμεν ἀκοῦσαι πάντα τὰ προστεταγμένα σοι ὑπὸ τοῦ Κυρίου.

controles.web: Therefore I sent to you at once, and it was good of you to come. Now therefore we are all here present in the sight of God to hear all things that have been commanded you by God.”
controles.kjv: Immediately therefore I sent to thee; and thou hast well done that thou art come. Now therefore are we all here present before God, to hear all things that are commanded thee of God.
controles.livre: Então logo eu enviei a ti; e bem fizeste em vir até aqui; agora pois estamos todos aqui presentes diante de Deus, para ouvir tudo quanto Deus tem te ordenado.

versos.grego: Ἀνοίξας δὲ Πέτρος τὸ στόμα εἶπεν Ἐπ’ ἀληθείας καταλαμβάνομαι ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν προσωπολήμπτης ὁ Θεός,

controles.web: Peter opened his mouth and said, “Truly I perceive that God doesn’t show favoritism;
controles.kjv: Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons:
controles.livre: E Pedro, abrindo a boca, disse: Reconheço que é verdade que Deus não faz acepção de pessoas.

versos.grego: ἀλλ’ ἐν παντὶ ἔθνει ὁ φοβούμενος αὐτὸν καὶ ἐργαζόμενος δικαιοσύνην δεκτὸς αὐτῷ ἐστιν·

controles.web: but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.
controles.kjv: But in every nation he that feareth him, and worketh righteousness, is accepted with him.
controles.livre: Mas sim, em toda nação, aquele que o teme, e pratica a justiça, este lhe é agradável.

versos.grego: τὸν λόγον ὃν ἀπέστειλεν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσραὴλ εὐαγγελιζόμενος εἰρήνην διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ· οὗτός ἐστιν πάντων Κύριος.

controles.web: The word which he sent to the children of Israel, preaching good news of peace by Jesus Christ—he is Lord of all—
controles.kjv: The word which God sent unto the children of Israel, preaching peace by Jesus Christ: (he is Lord of all:)
controles.livre: A palavra que Deus enviou aos filhos de Israel, anunciando o Evangelho da paz por meio de Jesus Cristo; este é o Senhor de todos.

versos.grego: ὑμεῖς οἴδατε τὸ γενόμενον ῥῆμα καθ’ ὅλης τῆς Ἰουδαίας, ἀρξάμενος ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας μετὰ τὸ βάπτισμα ὃ ἐκήρυξεν Ἰωάνης,

controles.web: you yourselves know what happened, which was proclaimed throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;
controles.kjv: That word, I say, ye know, which was published throughout all Judea, and began from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;
controles.livre: Vós sabeis da palavra que veio por toda a Judeia, começando desde a Galileia, depois do batismo que João pregou.

versos.grego: Ἰησοῦν τὸν ἀπὸ Ναζαρέθ, ὡς ἔχρισεν αὐτὸν ὁ Θεὸς Πνεύματι Ἁγίῳ καὶ δυνάμει, ὃς διῆλθεν εὐεργετῶν καὶ ἰώμενος πάντας τοὺς καταδυναστευομένους ὑπὸ τοῦ διαβόλου, ὅτι ὁ Θεὸς ἦν μετ’ αὐτοῦ·

controles.web: even Jesus of Nazareth, how God anointed him with the Holy Spirit and with power, who went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for God was with him.
controles.kjv: How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for God was with him.
controles.livre: E sobre Jesus de Nazaré; como Deus o ungiu com o Espírito Santo, e com poder; o qual percorreu os lugares fazendo o bem, e curando a todos os oprimidos pelo diabo; porque Deus era com ele.

versos.grego: καὶ ἡμεῖς μάρτυρες πάντων ὧν ἐποίησεν ἔν τε τῇ χώρᾳ τῶν Ἰουδαίων καὶ Ἱερουσαλήμ· ὃν καὶ ἀνεῖλαν κρεμάσαντες ἐπὶ ξύλου.

controles.web: We are witnesses of everything he did both in the country of the Jews, and in Jerusalem; whom they also killed, hanging him on a tree.
controles.kjv: And we are witnesses of all things which he did both in the land of the Jews, and in Jerusalem; whom they slew and hanged on a tree:
controles.livre: E nós somos testemunhas de todas as coisas que ele fez; tanto na terra dos judeus, como em Jerusalém; ao qual mataram, pendurando -o em um madeiro.

versos.grego: τοῦτον ὁ Θεὸς ἤγειρεν ἐν τῇ τρίτῃ ἡμέρᾳ καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτὸν ἐμφανῆ γενέσθαι,

controles.web: God raised him up the third day, and gave him to be revealed,
controles.kjv: Him God raised up the third day, and shewed him openly;
controles.livre: A este Deus ressuscitou ao terceiro dia, e fez com que fosse manifesto;

versos.grego: οὐ παντὶ τῷ λαῷ, ἀλλὰ μάρτυσιν τοῖς προκεχειροτονημένοις ὑπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ, ἡμῖν, οἵτινες συνεφάγομεν καὶ συνεπίομεν αὐτῷ μετὰ τὸ ἀναστῆναι αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν·

controles.web: not to all the people, but to witnesses who were chosen before by God, to us, who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.
controles.kjv: Not to all the people, but unto witnesses chosen before of God, even to us, who did eat and drink with him after he rose from the dead.
controles.livre: Não a todo o povo, mas sim a testemunhas determinadas por Deus com antecedência: a nós, que juntamente com ele comemos e bebemos, depois dele ter ressuscitado dos mortos.

versos.grego: καὶ παρήγγειλεν ἡμῖν κηρύξαι τῷ λαῷ καὶ διαμαρτύρασθαι ὅτι οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ ὡρισμένος ὑπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ Κριτὴς ζώντων καὶ νεκρῶν.

controles.web: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that this is he who is appointed by God as the Judge of the living and the dead.
controles.kjv: And he commanded us to preach unto the people, and to testify that it is he which was ordained of God to be the Judge of quick and dead.
controles.livre: E ele nos mandou pregar ao povo, e dar testemunho de que ele é o que foi ordenado por Deus para ser Juiz dos vivos e dos mortos.

versos.grego: τούτῳ πάντες οἱ προφῆται μαρτυροῦσιν, ἄφεσιν ἁμαρτιῶν λαβεῖν διὰ τοῦ ὀνόματος αὐτοῦ πάντα τὸν πιστεύοντα εἰς αὐτόν.

controles.web: All the prophets testify about him, that through his name everyone who believes in him will receive remission of sins.”
controles.kjv: To him give all the prophets witness, that through his name whosoever believeth in him shall receive remission of sins.
controles.livre: A este todos os profetas dão testemunho, de que todos os que nele crerem receberão perdão dos pecados por meio do seu nome.

versos.grego: Ἔτι λαλοῦντος τοῦ Πέτρου τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα ἐπέπεσεν τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ Ἅγιον ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς ἀκούοντας τὸν λόγον.

controles.web: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell on all those who heard the word.
controles.kjv: While Peter yet spake these words, the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the word.
controles.livre: E estando Pedro ainda falando estas palavras, o Espírito Santo caiu sobre todos os que ouviam a palavra.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐξέστησαν οἱ ἐκ περιτομῆς πιστοὶ ὅσοι συνῆλθαν τῷ Πέτρῳ, ὅτι καὶ ἐπὶ τὰ ἔθνη ἡ δωρεὰ τοῦ Ἁγίου Πνεύματος ἐκκέχυται·

controles.web: They of the circumcision who believed were amazed, as many as came with Peter, because the gift of the Holy Spirit was also poured out on the Gentiles.
controles.kjv: And they of the circumcision which believed were astonished, as many as came with Peter, because that on the Gentiles also was poured out the gift of the Holy Ghost.
controles.livre: E os crentes que eram da circuncisão, tantos quantos tinham vindo com Pedro, ficaram muito admirados de que também sobre os gentios fosse derramado o dom do Espírito Santo.

versos.grego: ἤκουον γὰρ αὐτῶν λαλούντων γλώσσαις καὶ μεγαλυνόντων τὸν Θεόν. τότε ἀπεκρίθη Πέτρος

controles.web: For they heard them speaking in other languages and magnifying God.   Then Peter answered,
controles.kjv: For they heard them speak with tongues, and magnify God. Then answered Peter,
controles.livre: Porque eles os ouviam falar em diversas línguas, e a engrandecer a Deus. Então Pedro respondeu:

versos.grego: Μήτι τὸ ὕδωρ δύναται κωλῦσαί τις τοῦ μὴ βαπτισθῆναι τούτους, οἵτινες τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ Ἅγιον ἔλαβον ὡς καὶ ἡμεῖς;

controles.web: “Can anyone forbid these people from being baptized with water? They have received the Holy Spirit just like us.”
controles.kjv: Can any man forbid water, that these should not be baptized, which have received the Holy Ghost as well as we?
controles.livre: Por acaso pode alguém impedir a água, para que não sejam batizados estes, que também, assim como nós, receberam o Espírito Santo?

versos.grego: προσέταξεν δὲ αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ βαπτισθῆναι. τότε ἠρώτησαν αὐτὸν ἐπιμεῖναι ἡμέρας τινάς.

controles.web: He commanded them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to stay some days.
controles.kjv: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord. Then prayed they him to tarry certain days.
controles.livre: E mandou que fossem batizados no nome do Senhor. Então lhe pediram que continuasse com eles por alguns dias.
